body:
## Changes
- Protect drafts, revisions and VIP content with active-account and ownership checks.
- Add reliable draft saving, local recovery, revision history and restore.
- Add chapter lifecycle actions and scheduled publishing through moderation.
- Persist uploaded media and make manuscript imports retry-safe.
- Add durable author notifications and an unread-count badge.
- Complete editable author profiles and refine the profile header and Studio actions.

## Validation
- 52 backend tests and 12 frontend tests passed during implementation.
- Backend/frontend type checks and production Docker builds passed.
- Browser checks covered author workflows, Light/Dark themes and responsive layouts.

## Database
Includes migrations `015_author_workflow.sql` and `016_author_launch_checklist.sql`.

## Merge order
Targets `feat/author-workspace` and includes only the new author workflow commit. Merge this PR before #54 to include these changes in the workspace PR to `main`.
title: feat(author): complete author workflows, notifications and profile improvements
head: feat/author-workflow-hardening

comments.body: Cross-branch P1 E2E finding for FE review: **issue #56** documents a *real Playwright* S09 failure where rapid B→A→B Undo left the server on stale A (test branch's earlier inline autosave). This PR has a different `useDraftPersistence.ts` hook with queued/serial saves and version guards, so please validate the actual new hook rather than transplanting the old `triggerAutosave` patch. Acceptance includes B→A→B before debounce, A in-flight→B, chapter/account switching, version-conflict recovery, immutable revision/outbox consistency and fresh Playwright readback. Exact repro/evidence and minimal required tests: https://github.com/Ephurin/Novel_sharing_platform/issues/56 . Please link your FE fix/test commit before P1 Codex safely ports the relevant patch to the isolated test branch; no merge of this whole PR into P1 without compatibility review.
